module_title: Important Stadiums - Football, Hockey, Tennis, and Regional Hubs
introduction: Moving beyond cricket, this level explores prominent global and domestic arenas dedicated to Football, Hockey, and Tennis. Understanding these venues is crucial as modern competitive exams frequently test multi-sport infrastructure.

core_concepts.title: India's Premier Football Arena
core_concepts.description: Salt Lake Stadium, officially known as 'Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan' in Kolkata, is India's largest football and multi-purpose stadium by capacity.

core_concepts.title: Global Hub of Field Hockey
core_concepts.description: The Birsa Munda International Hockey Stadium in Rourkela, Odisha, is the world's largest fully-seated hockey stadium. It was custom-built to host the 2023 Men's FIH Hockey World Cup alongside Bhubaneswar.

core_concepts.title: Legendary European Football Arenas
core_concepts.description: The 'Maracanã Stadium' (Rio de Janeiro, Brazil) and 'Camp Nou' (Barcelona, Spain) are legendary pillars of football history. Real Madrid's home turf, the 'Santiago Bernabéu' (Madrid, Spain), is equally iconic.

core_concepts.title: The Largest Tennis Stadium on Earth
core_concepts.description: Arthur Ashe Stadium, located in Flushing Meadows, New York (USA), is the largest tennis-specific stadium in the world and serves as the main court for the US Open Grand Slam.

core_concepts.title: Prominent Indian Cricket Bastions
core_concepts.description: Wankhede Stadium (Mumbai - venue of India's 2011 World Cup glory), M. Chinnaswamy Stadium (Bengaluru), and M.A. Chidambaram Stadium, popularly known as Chepauk (Chennai).

important_entities.name: Birsa Munda International Hockey Stadium
important_entities.significance: World's largest all-seater hockey stadium (Capacity: ~20,000 encoded seats).

important_entities.name: Salt Lake Stadium (VYBK)
important_entities.significance: The main hub of Indian football, hosting historic Kolkata derbies.

important_entities.name: Wankhede Stadium
important_entities.significance: Famous for MS Dhoni’s iconic 2011 World Cup-winning six and housing the BCCI headquarters.

important_entities.name: Kalinga Stadium
important_entities.significance: A multi-sport complex that has become the modern global epicenter for international hockey tournaments.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exams often use the vernacular name 'Chepauk Stadium'. Students looking strictly for 'M.A. Chidambaram Stadium' get confused. Both names refer to the exact same venue in Chennai.
Salt Lake Stadium might not appear explicitly in options; look for its official name: 'Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan'.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: Swami belongs to Bengaluru, Chidambaram stays in Chennai

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Whenever major modern hockey infrastructure like Kalinga Stadium or Birsa Munda Stadium is mentioned, map it directly to the state of Odisha.

exam_strategy_tips: Always memorize the specific venues of tennis Grand Slams (e.g., Arthur Ashe for US Open, Roland Garros for French Open).
Venues of recent global finals (like FIFA World Cups or ICC events) are primary targets for examiners.
